insights.summary: The agent performed exceptionally well, identifying a critical correctness bug in the vLLM evictor and implementing a high-quality optimization that matched the human reference. It demonstrated strong engineering practices by creating comparative benchmarks and verifying against existing test suites.
strengths: Excellent diagnostic skills regarding the stale-entry bug.
Clear and detailed documentation of changes.
weaknesses: Minor friction with initial test script creation (writing before reading).
Initial test scripts had bugs (ZeroDivisionError) that required an extra iteration to fix.
